_note: Juniper round 3 (Nov 6, Tiffany's notes 2:26am, site/livepatch/juniper-album-nov06/NOTES-round3-nov06.md): Palm Royale #1, Garden Glow #2, Lotus Cove #3; Peonies Burst, Cherry Blossom Jade, Palm Beach Tropical Pink Lime, Zesty Plume up to 'among the best'; OUT Mahj In Bloom Mat + Sunday Premium (Sunday Mahjong's 'Sunday Premium Mahjong Mat', the pair mat for its Sunday Tile Set); NEW candidate OMM Camellia (retired); WEAK at the bottom (hers to cut): Esme, Emerald Leopard in Bloom. 'box' = crop box on a hi-res photo (note 14). DRAFT order until she says it's final.

out.Sunday Premium: Tiffany Nov 6: out (tiles too bright for it, rack picks looked ridiculous). Real name: 'Sunday Premium Mahjong Mat' (Sunday Mahjong), made for their Sunday Tile Set.

mats.name: Palm Royale
mats.why: Your #1: the pink centre gives the most contrast with her greens (pink sits opposite green on the color wheel). Kelly cane lattice, blush palms and leopards, with enough green to hold the backs.

mats.name: Garden Glow – Emerald Green
mats.why: Looks made for the set: the deep forest ground matches her Forest Green Jade backs, and the pink wildflowers pick up the craks, bams and dots. Lower contrast than Palm Royale, so it's #2.

mats.name: Lotus Cove
mats.why: Oh My Mahjong designed Lotus Cove to go with Juniper, and they're sold together in the starter kit. The pink pond frame and lily pads echo her lotus flower tiles. It has no forest green, so it sits third.

mats.name: Peonies Burst
mats.why: Magenta peonies around a kelly green star: bold, and right on Juniper's pink and green.

mats.name: Cherry Blossom Jade
mats.why: Hot pink, chartreuse and kelly: all three of Juniper's loud colors in one mat.

mats.name: Palm Beach Tropical Pink Lime
mats.why: The chartreuse layer's best friend: a lime centre inside a hot pink tropical frame.

mats.name: Zesty Plume
mats.why: Hits every Juniper color: hot pink frame, teal and chartreuse foliage, and a white field like the faces.

mats.name: Botanical Jewel
mats.why: Forest green ground full of magenta and pink wildflowers: back, bams and craks in one.

mats.name: Midori Shadows
mats.why: Deep green with cranes and pink blossoms: the garden-at-night mood of the set. Also one of your Malachite picks.
mats.out_reason: Tiffany Nov 7 8:24pm: remove from the album

mats.name: Reba
mats.why: Deep green field inside a pink frame, with a bouquet of pinks and greens.

mats.name: Savannah
mats.why: Forest green with a pink floral medallion. Its olive and orange make it the moodier, Thanksgiving-to-Christmas pick.

mats.name: Viola
mats.why: Deep green center inside a dark floral border of pinks and lilacs: elegant and dark.

mats.name: YOTD Black
mats.why: Black ground with pink roses and a green dragon, for the emerald dragon tiles. The darkest pick here.

mats.name: Crane & Moon
mats.why: Deep green-navy night sky with white cranes, coral flowers and a gold moon: a garden after dark, like the set.
mats.out_reason: Tiffany Nov 7 8:24pm: remove from the album

mats.name: Enchanted
mats.why: Hot pink and kelly green chinoiserie from Oh My Mahjong: the same pink and green, at the same brightness as the faces. Retired.

mats.name: Chinoiserie Songbird
mats.why: A chinoiserie garden in pink, mint and lime: the world of the peacock and pagoda tiles.

mats.name: Day Dreamer (Pink and Green)
mats.why: Hot pink and lime medallion: picks up the chartreuse layer and the pink dots. Sold on Etsy.
mats.out_reason: Tiffany Nov 7 8:24pm: remove from the album

mats.name: Tropical Travels
mats.why: Pink, kelly and teal tropical leaves: preppy and bright.

mats.name: Cheetah in Chinoiserie
mats.why: A pagoda garden in pinks and greens under a navy sky, like the pagoda and flower tiles. Sold on Etsy.

mats.name: Whimsical Chinoiserie Meeting in the Pavilion
mats.why: Pagodas, pink blossoms and green gardens: the flower tiles as a full scene. Sold on Etsy.

mats.name: Grand Rose Medallion Chinoiserie
mats.why: Pink roses on big green lily pads around a medallion, close to the lotus flower tiles.

mats.name: YOTD Pink
mats.why: Blush ground, pink roses and a green dragon: the dragon tiles, softened.

mats.name: YOTD White
mats.why: White ground like the faces, with roses and a teal dragon: the lightest of the dragon mats.

mats.name: The Dahlia
mats.why: Soft pink and teal-green toile: the quiet option that lets the faces do the talking.

mats.name: Green Bamboo Blossoms
mats.why: Bamboo lattice with pink blossoms, like the bam tiles. Its sage green is softer and a little earthier than the backs.

mats.name: Green Malachite
mats.why: A green stone pattern, like the jade-look stone pattern on her backs. Tone on tone; the faces bring the pink.

mats.name: Evergreen
mats.why: Deep green with ferns: tone on tone, like the backs. One of your Malachite picks.

mats.name: Emerald Cove
mats.why: A swirled emerald that looks like the tile backs themselves. Sleek and moody.

mats.name: Emerald Teal & Celadon Leatherette
mats.why: The solid pick: the emerald side matches the teal layer, and the celadon side flips it softer.

mats.name: Camellia
mats.why: Pink camellias with deep forest-green leaves on a soft pink ground: the leaves pick up her Forest Green Jade backs, the blooms her pink faces. A great match (Tiffany Nov 7). Retired.

mats.name: Esme
mats.why: Matched on the faces: her pink blossoms and teal-green leaves pick up Juniper's pink faces and teal layer. Retired.

mats.name: Emerald Leopard in Bloom
mats.why: Weak, on your list to cut: emerald lattice frame with pink peonies and a leopard. It didn't wow you.
